ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE POLICE UNIFORMS AND EQUIPMENT REGULATION ACT
[Attached Form No. 4] <Revised December 31, 2020>
Applications may also be submitted through the National Police Civil Complaints Portal (minwon.police.go.kr).

APPLICATION FOR REISSUANCE OF MANUFACTURING OR SALES BUSINESS REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE
Select applicable item: [ ] Police uniforms  [ ] Police equipment
Mark √ in the appropriate box.

Application receipt number: __________
Date received: __________    Processing period: 5 days

Applicant (representative if a corporation):
Name: __________    Date of birth (including nationality if foreign): __________
Address: __________________________________    Telephone: __________

Business establishment:
Trade name or corporate name: _________________________________
Business registration number: __________
Location: __________________________________    Telephone: __________

Reason for reissuance:
________________________________________________________________
________________________________________________________________

Pursuant to Article 3 (2) of the Police Uniforms and Equipment Regulation Act and Article 5 (3) of its Enforcement Rule, I hereby apply for reissuance of the registration certificate for:
[ ] Manufacturing police uniforms
[ ] Selling police uniforms
[ ] Manufacturing police equipment
[ ] Selling police equipment

Year ______  Month ______  Day ______
Applicant (representative): __________________ [Signature or seal]

To: Head of City/Do Police Agency
    Head of ○○ Regional Coast Guard
    Commander of Autonomous Police Corps

DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED BY APPLICANT:
Damaged registration certificate. If the certificate was lost, state the circumstances of loss in the “Reason for reissuance” field.
Fee: None.

PROCESSING PROCEDURE:
Prepare application → Receive application → Verify → Approve → Prepare registration certificate → Reissue registration certificate.
Applicant → Head of City/Do Police Agency / Head of ○○ Regional Coast Guard / Commander of Autonomous Police Corps (responsible at each subsequent stage).

Paper: 210 mm × 297 mm [woodfree paper (80 g/m²) or medium-grade paper (80 g/m²)].
